title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 369 (Saving of existing liabilities)

content.overview: The registration of a company in pursuance of this Part shall not affect its rights or liabilities in respect of any debt or obligation incurred, or any contract entered into, by, to, with, or on behalf of, the company before registration.
content.glance: Pre-registration debts, obligations and contracts continue unaffected by registration under this Part.
